updates.body: When introducing token revocation, add a module-level _REVOKED set in auth.py and a revoke_token(token_id) helper. Session.revoke() must call it.
updates.rationale: The run added revocation in auth.py + session.py with green tests; pattern recurred and merits capture.

updates.body:
## To add a new auth side-effect
1. Add the side-effect to auth.py.
2. Import + call from session.py at the right lifecycle hook.
3. Add a test in tests/auth/.
4. Run full test suite, not just unit.
updates.rationale: Three-step procedure consistently led to a green test run.
